question: How many MBA graduates does India produce annually?
idealClarificationQuestions: All approved institutions (AICTE-approved + IIMs + autonomous)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Sum across institution categories × intake × completion rate.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: AICTE-approved MBA/PGDM seats: ~3.7 lakh annually (recent data).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus autonomous/private without AICTE (XLRI, ISB, S.P. Jain global): ~3,000.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~4-4.5 lakh MBA graduates per year.
